what: Exact projection from the AMR shape coordinates eta to PyCBC's physical parameters, for the reduced-patch SSB template family in the companion repository.  xi = E diag(1/sqrt(lam)) eta and p = p_ref + sigma_p xi_p, where xi is the offset from the reference point in the research's shape units (multiples of sigma) and eta is the chart the sampler refines in.  The map is linear in eta, which is why the coordinates cannot simply be renamed.

geometry.note: The geometry the sampler actually used: its first-level widths reproduce results/2026-10-18/amr_sampler/validate.json and the map reproduces the recorded injection.  The files under results/2026-10-16/adaptive_refs/windowed_amr/ and results/2026-10-17/ hold a different windowed metric (lam_0 = 4.05e-4, stiff = 0 1 2) and do not reproduce it.

parameters.name: mchirp
parameters.convention: Chirp mass (m1 m2)^(3/5)/(m1+m2)^(1/5) in solar masses; the same quantity in the project and in PyCBC (pycbc.waveform.parameters.mchirp, pycbc.conversions.mchirp_from_mass1_mass2).

parameters.name: q
parameters.convention: The project's linear coordinate is q_proj = m2/m1 <= 1 (experiments/ratio_cells/coordinates.py); PyCBC's q is m1/m2 >= 1 (pycbc.waveform.parameters.q, pycbc.conversions.q_from_mass1_mass2).  kind = reciprocal stores 1/(q_ref + sigma xi), i.e. PyCBC's q.

parameters.name: spin1z
parameters.convention: z component of the first component's dimensionless spin; the same in the project and in PyCBC (pycbc.waveform.parameters.spin1z).

parameters.name: spin2z
parameters.convention: z component of the second component's dimensionless spin; the same in the project and in PyCBC (pycbc.waveform.parameters.spin2z).

injection.note: Recorded by results/2026-10-18/amr_sampler/amr_sampler.py: xi_int = [3, -2, 1.5, -1] in shape units and eta = sqrt(lam) (E^T xi) from the same geometry.  The map is checked against this pair on load; the round trip returns xi to 9e-16.  The fifth and sixth eta components are small but their 1/sqrt(lam) is 1.6e4 and 1.1e6, so they carry order-unity contributions to xi and must not be dropped.
